## Lead Care With Light**®**

## Helping Patients & Families

Acadia Healthcare’s network of mental health and addiction treatment facilities provides premier
care for patients of all ages and genders. We offer every level of care, including acute inpatient
hospitals, residential treatment centers, specialty programs, a variety of outpatient treatment
options, and medication-assisted opioid treatment clinics. Whatever your or your loved one’s needs
may be, we can help.

[ What We Treat][81] [Who We Treat][82] [What Makes Us Different][83]

## Valuing Staff & Culture

Acadia Healthcare’s team consists of devoted professionals who possess a wealth of knowledge in
various disciplines within the behavioral health field. Regardless of the level of care in which you
or your loved one receives treatment, you will benefit from research-based interventions that are
delivered by highly qualified, skilled, and compassionate clinicians.

[Our Culture][84]

## Building Collaboration & Opportunity

Acadia Healthcare prides itself on being a thought leader in the behavioral healthcare industry.
With a focus on innovating the way that mental health and addiction treatment is implemented, we
stay ahead of other behavioral healthcare companies by remaining up to date with evolving research,
delivering superior care in state-of-the-art settings, and ultimately setting the standard for
excellence in the treatment of psychiatric and addiction concerns.

[Professional Referent & Facility Collaboration][85] [Recruiting][86]

## Connecting People & Communities

At Acadia Healthcare, we believe that having a positive impact on the industry goes beyond providing
exceptional care at the facilities within our treatment network. We believe that we must reach out
to those in the communities we serve to ensure that everyone in need knows that they have access to
quality care. By providing education and promoting awareness, we are also able to help in reducing
the stigma that surrounds behavioral health treatment.

[News Coverage & Events][87]

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Association for Cognitive and Behavioral Psychotherapy

since 1999
WELCOME
St Petersburg is looking forward to host the IACBT-C 2024 as we believe it will significantly
contribute to the development of cognitive behavioral therapy in our region, as well as throughout
the Russian Federation and in the post-Soviet area.

IACBT-C is an outstanding event in the world of professionals in the field of mental health and
socionomics, a great source for improving skills and gaining new modern knowledge for cognitive
behavioral therapy and psychotherapy in general, a powerful impetus to professional growth and
personal fulfillment.

Respectfully yours,
**Dmitrii Kovpak**
**President of the Association**
**For Cognitive Behavioral Psychotherapy of Russia**
**Dear colleagues! We are proud to inform you about EABCT Congress 2024!**

This years EABCT Congress is taking place in the vibrant city of Belgrade, Serbia, from September
4-7, with the theme, "New Age of CBT - Challenges and Perspectives."
This is an opportunity to:
• Engage with world-renowned speakers and CBT practitioners (registration is open!)
• Share your research and insights (call for abstracts is open!)
• Network with peers
• Experience the rich culture and hospitality of Belgrade.

Your participation will not only contribute to the advancement of CBT but also offer you an
unforgettable experience in one of Europe's most captivating and vibrant cities.

Registration is available on [eabct2024.org][1]

See you in Belgrade!
Association of Cognitive and Behavioral Psychotherapy (Russia) Founded in 1999 We bring together
mental health professionals with the mission to promote cognitive and behavioral therapy in Russian
Federation as well as provide highly professional help and support for our patients and clients.

**Address**
197374 St. Petersburg, 62 Primorsky Ave., building 1, office 51-N Russia
**Phone: **+7(911)9224419

[www.associationcbt.ru][2]


We are the only organization which has State Educational License and legally provide CBT training
with local analog of CE for mental health professionals.
Every year RACBP publishes a few professional journals registered with ISBN and in Russian science
citation index.

25 regional branches in Russia - our members include over 1000 clinical professional - over 3000

contribute to the development of cognitive behavioral therapy in our region, as well as throughout
the Russian Federation and in the post-Soviet area.

socionomics, a great source for improving skills and gaining new modern knowledge for cognitive
behavioral therapy and psychotherapy in general, a powerful impetus to professional growth and
personal fulfillment.

**Dmitrii Kovpak**
**President of the Association**
**For Cognitive Behavioral Psychotherapy of Russia**

4-7, with the theme, "New Age of CBT - Challenges and Perspectives."
This is an opportunity to:
• Engage with world-renowned speakers and CBT practitioners (registration is open!)

• Network with peers
• Experience the rich culture and hospitality of Belgrade.

unforgettable experience in one of Europe's most captivating and vibrant cities.

## С чем к нам чаще всего обращаются

Я постоянно беспокоюсь, у меня **тревога**, **страхи**, **приступы паники**, я во всем сомневаюсь
и всего боюсь.

Я не могу заставить себя начать заниматься делами, **постоянно все откладываю**, не могу
yсконцентрироваться.

У меня **проблемы со сном**: я не могу уснуть, сон чуткий, я не могу выспаться, чувствую себя сонным
днем.

У меня сердцебиение, разные боли **неприятные ощущения ** **в теле** каждый раз, как я понервничаю
или разозлюсь.

У меня **плохое настроение**,
апатия, ни от чего не получаю
удовольствия, нет интересов.

У меня постоянно напряжение,
меня **все раздражает**,** злит**,
бесит, я не могу никого видеть.

У меня **проблемы **
**в сексуальной жизни**, пропало
желание, совсем нет влечения.

Я **постоянно уставший**, совсем
нет сил, не могу расслабиться,
отдохнуть, восстановиться.

Мы помогаем с любыми психиатрическими и психосоматическими расстройствами — от первых тревожных
звоночков до сложных состояний.

Приходите один, с партнёром или всей семьёй.

## Success Stories

I just wanted to write a quick note to say thank you. 20 years ago (when I was only 15!) I found
Feeling Good at my local bookstore and brought it home with me. I’ve carried it with me EVERYWHERE
I’ve moved (and I’ve moved a lot!) — because it literally changed my life. And it continues to
ground me and bring me comfort/relief whenever I have an anxiety or depression relapse.
Recently, I discovered your podcast. What a thrill ! I love to put it on after a long day and learn
about your new techniques, behind-the-scenes vignettes, and enjoy your humor and humility. What a
GIFT you have given so many people for so, so many years.
Thank you, thank you !!
Amy Maloof
I can’t even begin to describe how lucky I feel to have found David’s training group. Once I became
licensed, I began searching for training opportunities because I knew I still had a lot to learn,
but I had no idea how much my life would improve by attending the TEAM training groups.
Not only has my professional life improved dramatically, but the skills David teaches have also
improved my personal life as well. I am forever grateful to David for being so generous with his
time and there’s no place I’d rather be then learning from him!
Alisha Beale
My name is Huyen 20 years old girl living in Vietnam.
Thank you so much, your book is like magical happen to my life. I luckily buy it in the time I am in
a depression with the faith that I’m gonna be cured although that time I almost committed suicide.
I was feel healed, cured, filled after I read your book. I understood my pains my thoughts and most
of it I found hope that from now on, I’m not alone to fight with this. I have your book with me.
Something that I know for sure will lead my life out of the dark.
I love psychologist too since I was a kid after watching my mom suffer depression once in her life.
But then, later on, I have to go through that too, but you really inspired me to expose it, keep
learning what I love and help other people too.
Thank you so much for the great things you have done to this world!
Huyen Thanh Nguyen

## Lead Care With Light**®**

## Helping Patients & Families

Acadia Healthcare’s network of mental health and addiction treatment facilities provides premier
care for patients of all ages and genders. We offer every level of care, including acute inpatient
hospitals, residential treatment centers, specialty programs, a variety of outpatient treatment
options, and medication-assisted opioid treatment clinics. Whatever your or your loved one’s needs
may be, we can help.

[ What We Treat][81] [Who We Treat][82] [What Makes Us Different][83]

## Valuing Staff & Culture

Acadia Healthcare’s team consists of devoted professionals who possess a wealth of knowledge in
various disciplines within the behavioral health field. Regardless of the level of care in which you
or your loved one receives treatment, you will benefit from research-based interventions that are
delivered by highly qualified, skilled, and compassionate clinicians.

[Our Culture][84]

## Building Collaboration & Opportunity

Acadia Healthcare prides itself on being a thought leader in the behavioral healthcare industry.
With a focus on innovating the way that mental health and addiction treatment is implemented, we
stay ahead of other behavioral healthcare companies by remaining up to date with evolving research,
delivering superior care in state-of-the-art settings, and ultimately setting the standard for
excellence in the treatment of psychiatric and addiction concerns.

[Professional Referent & Facility Collaboration][85] [Recruiting][86]

## Connecting People & Communities

At Acadia Healthcare, we believe that having a positive impact on the industry goes beyond providing
exceptional care at the facilities within our treatment network. We believe that we must reach out
to those in the communities we serve to ensure that everyone in need knows that they have access to
quality care. By providing education and promoting awareness, we are also able to help in reducing
the stigma that surrounds behavioral health treatment.

[News Coverage & Events][87]

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to

  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

# Welcome to Access Behavioral Health

Since 2001, Access Behavioral Health (ABH) has managed the mental health and substance use services
for Medicaid recipients and residents of northwest Florida. We have created a network of providers
who focus on the core principles of recovery: strengths-based, person-centered, individualized
treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders. Through
contracting, monitoring, network management, and quality improvement efforts, we have improved the
coordination, integration, and management of service delivery to those with emotional, mental, or
addictive disorders.

### Individualized treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders

ABH has developed a comprehensive, community-based system of care by contracting with experienced
providers offering evidence-based services. We contract with a wide variety of behavioral health
care providers to respect and ensure consumer choice and to meet the special health care needs of
our Medicaid members. Guided by our mission of “helping people,” our specialized team strives to
meet the behavioral health needs of those we serve.

who focus on the core principles of recovery: strengths-based, person-centered, individualized
treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders. Through

coordination, integration, and management of service delivery to those with emotional, mental, or

##  What Is Behavioral Health Integration?

### Mental Health Services All Under One Roof

Behavioral health integration combines physical and mental healthcare services within one healthcare
setting to address the interconnection between a patient’s physical and mental health. Traditionally
treated separately, physical and mental health are actually interconnected, with one in three people
having both conditions. Integration promotes a holistic approach, incorporating mental health
services into healthcare settings. This simultaneous treatment of physical and psychological health
leads to increased revenue for providers and improved patient access to care.

# Association for Cognitive and Behavioral Psychotherapy

since 1999
WELCOME
St Petersburg is looking forward to host the IACBT-C 2024 as we believe it will significantly
contribute to the development of cognitive behavioral therapy in our region, as well as throughout
the Russian Federation and in the post-Soviet area.

IACBT-C is an outstanding event in the world of professionals in the field of mental health and
socionomics, a great source for improving skills and gaining new modern knowledge for cognitive
behavioral therapy and psychotherapy in general, a powerful impetus to professional growth and
personal fulfillment.

Respectfully yours,
**Dmitrii Kovpak**
**President of the Association**
**For Cognitive Behavioral Psychotherapy of Russia**
**Dear colleagues! We are proud to inform you about EABCT Congress 2024!**

This years EABCT Congress is taking place in the vibrant city of Belgrade, Serbia, from September
4-7, with the theme, "New Age of CBT - Challenges and Perspectives."
This is an opportunity to:
• Engage with world-renowned speakers and CBT practitioners (registration is open!)
• Share your research and insights (call for abstracts is open!)
• Network with peers
• Experience the rich culture and hospitality of Belgrade.

Your participation will not only contribute to the advancement of CBT but also offer you an
unforgettable experience in one of Europe's most captivating and vibrant cities.

Registration is available on [eabct2024.org][1]

See you in Belgrade!

WELCOME

contribute to the development of cognitive behavioral therapy in our region, as well as throughout
the Russian Federation and in the post-Soviet area.

IACBT-C is an outstanding event in the world of professionals in the field of mental health and
socionomics, a great source for improving skills and gaining new modern knowledge for cognitive
behavioral therapy and psychotherapy in general, a powerful impetus to professional growth and
personal fulfillment.

Respectfully yours,
**Dmitrii Kovpak**
**President of the Association**
**For Cognitive Behavioral Psychotherapy of Russia**
**Dear colleagues! We are proud to inform you about EABCT Congress 2024!**

This years EABCT Congress is taking place in the vibrant city of Belgrade, Serbia, from September
4-7, with the theme, "New Age of CBT - Challenges and Perspectives."
This is an opportunity to:
• Engage with world-renowned speakers and CBT practitioners (registration is open!)
• Share your research and insights (call for abstracts is open!)
• Network with peers
• Experience the rich culture and hospitality of Belgrade.

Your participation will not only contribute to the advancement of CBT but also offer you an
unforgettable experience in one of Europe's most captivating and vibrant cities.

Registration is available on [eabct2024.org][1]

See you in Belgrade!

# Homepage

DABATEM *(**Istanbul Center for Behavioral Sciences*** – formerly the *Istanbul Center for Behavior
Research and Therapy*) is an independent research center internationally recognized for its
pioneering research into mental health effects of wars, torture, and earthquakes, and their
effective treatment. It has been founded and is currently directed by [Professor Metin Başoğlu][56].

Mass trauma events affect large numbers of people and lead to a serious mental health problem around
the world. Effective dealing with this problem requires a mental healthcare model based on
interventions that are (1) theoretically sound, (2) proven to be effective, (3) brief, (4) easy to
train therapists in their delivery, (5) practicable in different cultures, and (6) suitable for
dissemination through media other than professional therapists, such as lay people, self-help tools,
and mass media. Current trauma treatments do not meet more than two or three of these requirements.

DABATEM has conducted extensive research over 40 years with trauma survivors to develop a
psychological treatment ([Control-Focused Behavioral Treatment – CFBT][57]), which meets all of the
above requirements. CFBT is a brief intervention that reduces traumatic stress by enhancing** sense
of control** over (or resilience against) trauma.  [Available evidence][58] suggests that it
achieves greater improvement than other evidence-based treatments.

DABATEM has also developed a [mental healthcare model][59] for earthquake survivors that
incorporates various brief and innovative applications of CFBT and treatment delivery strategies
that enable cost-effective dissemination of care to large survivor populations. Work is in progress
to develop a similar model for survivors of war and torture. A recent [treatment study][60] has
shown that CFBT is highly effective in survivors of war and torture.

# Practice Success

Ensora Health builds EHR and practice management software for mental, behavioral, and rehabilitative
therapy – designed to help your practice and clients thrive.
[Request a demo][140]

## TheraNest

### Mental Health

TheraNest is a mental health EHR and practice management solution built to help you save time,
reduce admin, and run a successful practice.
[Start a free trial][141]

## Fusion

### Rehab Therapy

Fusion’s EHR simplifies documentation, scheduling, and billing – so physical, occupational, and
speech therapy teams can work through the day with ease.
[Request a demo][142]

## Lightening the load for every part of your practice

Whether you’re a solo therapist, part of a large group, or a member of the admin support staff,
we’re here to help you deliver exceptional care.

Mental health solo practices
When you’re a solo therapist, you carry the full weight of your practice. You need fewer systems to
manage, fewer fires to chase, and more space for meaningful moments. TheraNest helps you stay
organized and sustainable without extra effort.
[[Resources] Learn More][143]
Mental health group practices
Group practices juggle shifting schedules, tight cash flow, and costly no-shows. Supporting
clinicians and clients is key, but admin tasks feel overwhelming. You deserve a simpler path
forward.
[[Resources] Learn More][144]
Rehab therapy
Documentation, authorizations, and shifting schedules can push admin work late into the night. Built
by therapists who understand, Fusion streamlines your workflow in one EHR — so your PT/ OT/ SLP team
can avoid burnout and focus on clients.
[[Resources] Learn More][145]

## Practice success with Ensora Health

We build and fine-tune our solutions with input from clinicians, their clients, and practice owners
and administrators. That’s why they are designed to solve real problems, not just check boxes.

### TheraNest

Automate and simplify admin work with an all-in-one mental health EHR and PMS.

[Explore TheraNest][146]

### Fusion

Improve workflows and patient outcomes with the trusted EHR for physical, occupational, and speech
therapy.

[Explore Fusion][147]

днем.

У меня сердцебиение, разные боли **неприятные ощущения ** **в теле** каждый раз, как я понервничаю
или разозлюсь.

У меня **плохое настроение**,
апатия, ни от чего не получаю
удовольствия, нет интересов.

меня **все раздражает**,** злит**,
бесит, я не могу никого видеть.

У меня **проблемы **
**в сексуальной жизни**, пропало
желание, совсем нет влечения.

Я **постоянно уставший**, совсем
нет сил, не могу расслабиться,
отдохнуть, восстановиться.

Мы помогаем с любыми психиатрическими и психосоматическими расстройствами — от первых тревожных
звоночков до сложных состояний.

yсконцентрироваться.

днем.

У меня сердцебиение, разные боли **неприятные ощущения ** **в теле** каждый раз, как я понервничаю

бесит, я не могу никого видеть.

У меня **проблемы **

нет сил, не могу расслабиться,

## Success Stories

I just wanted to write a quick note to say thank you. 20 years ago (when I was only 15!) I found
Feeling Good at my local bookstore and brought it home with me. I’ve carried it with me EVERYWHERE
I’ve moved (and I’ve moved a lot!) — because it literally changed my life. And it continues to
ground me and bring me comfort/relief whenever I have an anxiety or depression relapse.
Recently, I discovered your podcast. What a thrill ! I love to put it on after a long day and learn
about your new techniques, behind-the-scenes vignettes, and enjoy your humor and humility. What a
GIFT you have given so many people for so, so many years.
Thank you, thank you !!
Amy Maloof
I can’t even begin to describe how lucky I feel to have found David’s training group. Once I became
licensed, I began searching for training opportunities because I knew I still had a lot to learn,
but I had no idea how much my life would improve by attending the TEAM training groups.
Not only has my professional life improved dramatically, but the skills David teaches have also
improved my personal life as well. I am forever grateful to David for being so generous with his
time and there’s no place I’d rather be then learning from him!
Alisha Beale
My name is Huyen 20 years old girl living in Vietnam.
Thank you so much, your book is like magical happen to my life. I luckily buy it in the time I am in
a depression with the faith that I’m gonna be cured although that time I almost committed suicide.
I was feel healed, cured, filled after I read your book. I understood my pains my thoughts and most
of it I found hope that from now on, I’m not alone to fight with this. I have your book with me.
Something that I know for sure will lead my life out of the dark.
I love psychologist too since I was a kid after watching my mom suffer depression once in her life.
But then, later on, I have to go through that too, but you really inspired me to expose it, keep
learning what I love and help other people too.
Thank you so much for the great things you have done to this world!
Huyen Thanh Nguyen

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Sliding Fee

The Sliding Fee Program offers reduced prices for clinic visits to individuals and families who
qualify. With a sliding fee scale, we lower costs so no one will be denied access to health services
due to an inability to pay.

[Learn More ][70]

### Services

Horizon Health provides dental, medical, and behavioral health services at 27 medical and dental
clinics in 19 rural South Dakota communities.

[Areas of Care][71]

### Support the Horizon Health Foundation

Your generosity helps us provide essential healthcare services to rural communities in South Dakota.
By donating to the Horizon Health Foundation, you make a meaningful difference in the lives of
individuals and families who rely on us for quality medical, dental, and behavioral health care.

**Donate Today**: Your support enables us to continue offering compassionate care to those who need
it most.

## About Us

[Company][36]

### Reasons why people choose ITO

Over 100 years since the foundation in 1916, we have been developing numerous physiotherapy
products. Although our top-quality products have been widely acclaimed in Japan and overseas, we are
never satisfied with the current situation. We will continue to improve and develop new products to
create a more age-friendly and healthier society.

We have been exporting our high-quality products for over 30 years more than 100 countries through
our reliable partners in each country. To supply our products worldwide, we are certified for ISO
13485. We have also passed the strict international quality standards and specifications such as CE,
FDA and UL.

## Explore Therapy Technologies & Devices

### Focused Shockwave Therapy

Focused shockwave therapy delivers concentrated acoustic energy into targeted tissue areas, making
it suitable for deep musculoskeletal conditions, chronic pain, tendon injuries, and precise
rehabilitation applications.
[ View Devices ][77] [ Learn Technology ][78]

### Radial Shockwave Therapy

Radial shockwave therapy spreads acoustic energy across a broader treatment area, making it ideal
for superficial pain, muscle tension, myofascial conditions, and sports recovery treatments.
[ View Devices ][79] [ Learn Technology ][80]

### Magneto Therapy

Magneto therapy uses pulsed electromagnetic fields to stimulate deeper tissues, support pain
management, improve recovery, and assist rehabilitation for muscles, joints, tendons, and soft
tissue conditions.
[ View Devices ][81] [ Learn Technology ][82]

### Laser Therapy

Laser therapy delivers therapeutic light energy to support tissue repair, reduce discomfort, improve
circulation, and assist recovery in physical therapy and rehabilitation settings.
[ View Devices ][83] [ Learn Technology ][84]

### Tecar Therapy

TECAR therapy uses capacitive and resistive radiofrequency energy to stimulate deep tissues, improve
circulation, support soft tissue recovery, and enhance rehabilitation efficiency.
[ View Devices ][85] [ Learn Technology ][86]

### Ultrasound Therapy

Ultrasound therapy uses high-frequency sound waves to penetrate soft tissues, support tissue
healing, relieve pain, and improve circulation in clinical physiotherapy applications.
[ View Devices ][87] [ Learn Technology ][88]

MSW, LSW • Licensed Social Worker

Peter Bogdonavic, MSW, LSW, is a virtual therapist specializing in adult mental health. He offers

individual and couples counseling, she creates a safe space for clients to reconnect mind and body,
fostering healing and personal growth.

## Professor Nazaraliev

Doctor of Medical Sciences, Professor, founder of Nazaraliev Medical Center. Over 35 years of
practice in drug and alcohol addiction treatment.

Author of a unique treatment method officially recognized by the Russian Academy of Medical Sciences
(RAMS) in 2011.

## What we treat

Our center specializes in treating drug addiction, alcoholism, synthetic drugs, as well as mental
disorders including depression, neuroses and schizophrenia.

The Nazaraliev Method is a holistic approach. We recommend hospitalization together with a
companion. The triple alliance doctor–patient–co-dependent ensures up to 83% remission.

# We exist to improve children’s behavioral health across
# our region.

The New England Children’s Behavioral Health Network has a vision of a system of care that is
preventive, upstream, collaborative, accessible, equitable and family-centered. Through our advocacy
and network-building we work to improve children’s behavioral health across the region.

[ About Us ][42]

# Preventative

# Collaborative

# Accessible

# Equitable

# Family-centered

# Preventative Collaborative Accessible Equitable Family-centered

**ABOUT US**

## Children’s behavioral health is our priority.

We know that the fragmentation of children’s behavioral health care is not unique to one state. The
Network’s collaborative, regional approach allows us to bring together stakeholders to learn and
pool resources. Our stakeholders are currently located across Rhode Island, Connecticut and
Massachusetts.

excellence and compassionate, effective treatment for all who are entrusted into our care.
Recommended by doctors and therapists across the world, we are recognized for providing safe and
successful treatment for those who are struggling with addiction and a wide range of complex
behavioral health disorders. Our renowned programs have resulted in positive change in the lives of
over 34,000 residents and more than 90,000 family members.

We are here to help you through this difficult time. It takes courage to seek treatment, and we are
committed to helping you through this process.

With extensive training and decades of experience, Sierra Tucson maintains a high standard of
excellence in the clinical treatment programs that we offer for individuals aged 18 and older, who

return to your family, friends, and a productive lifestyle.

Solera offers virtual GI treatment, using personalized matching to connect individuals with the

Solera offers a personalized digital hypertension management program that integrates advanced
technology and human support.

62.9% of users showed a reduction in systolic blood pressure at one year post enrollment.

Solera offers a personalized digital mental health management program that integrates advanced
technology and human support.

32% of users reduce stress after 30 days using Headspace.
‍

Solera offers a personalized digital MSK management program that integrates advanced technology and
human support.

71.6% of high acuity users achieved a 30% decrease in pain.
‍

and human support.

‍

Solera matches women to appropriate programs that cater to their unique needs at every stage of
life, providing care across the entire spectrum of women’s health.

Solera offers weight management that extends beyond simple diet plans. We have a purpose-built
network that addresses various health needs through evidence-based lifestyle change programs.

Combined In-Home Services

families whose children are at risk of removal due to abuse and/or neglect.

Therapeutic Foster Network programs offer a variety of services to children and families, all of
which are designed to promote expedited and successful reunifications.

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.

# Welcome to Access Behavioral Health

Since 2001, Access Behavioral Health (ABH) has managed the mental health and substance use services
for Medicaid recipients and residents of northwest Florida. We have created a network of providers
who focus on the core principles of recovery: strengths-based, person-centered, individualized
treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders. Through
contracting, monitoring, network management, and quality improvement efforts, we have improved the
coordination, integration, and management of service delivery to those with emotional, mental, or
addictive disorders.

### Individualized treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders

ABH has developed a comprehensive, community-based system of care by contracting with experienced
providers offering evidence-based services. We contract with a wide variety of behavioral health
care providers to respect and ensure consumer choice and to meet the special health care needs of
our Medicaid members. Guided by our mission of “helping people,” our specialized team strives to
meet the behavioral health needs of those we serve.

##  What Is Behavioral Health Integration?

### Mental Health Services All Under One Roof

Behavioral health integration combines physical and mental healthcare services within one healthcare
setting to address the interconnection between a patient’s physical and mental health. Traditionally
treated separately, physical and mental health are actually interconnected, with one in three people
having both conditions. Integration promotes a holistic approach, incorporating mental health
services into healthcare settings. This simultaneous treatment of physical and psychological health
leads to increased revenue for providers and improved patient access to care.

# Homepage

DABATEM *(**Istanbul Center for Behavioral Sciences*** – formerly the *Istanbul Center for Behavior
Research and Therapy*) is an independent research center internationally recognized for its
pioneering research into mental health effects of wars, torture, and earthquakes, and their
effective treatment. It has been founded and is currently directed by [Professor Metin Başoğlu][56].

Mass trauma events affect large numbers of people and lead to a serious mental health problem around
the world. Effective dealing with this problem requires a mental healthcare model based on
interventions that are (1) theoretically sound, (2) proven to be effective, (3) brief, (4) easy to
train therapists in their delivery, (5) practicable in different cultures, and (6) suitable for
dissemination through media other than professional therapists, such as lay people, self-help tools,
and mass media. Current trauma treatments do not meet more than two or three of these requirements.

DABATEM has conducted extensive research over 40 years with trauma survivors to develop a
psychological treatment ([Control-Focused Behavioral Treatment – CFBT][57]), which meets all of the
above requirements. CFBT is a brief intervention that reduces traumatic stress by enhancing** sense
of control** over (or resilience against) trauma.  [Available evidence][58] suggests that it
achieves greater improvement than other evidence-based treatments.

DABATEM has also developed a [mental healthcare model][59] for earthquake survivors that
incorporates various brief and innovative applications of CFBT and treatment delivery strategies
that enable cost-effective dissemination of care to large survivor populations. Work is in progress
to develop a similar model for survivors of war and torture. A recent [treatment study][60] has
shown that CFBT is highly effective in survivors of war and torture.

# Practice Success

Ensora Health builds EHR and practice management software for mental, behavioral, and rehabilitative
therapy – designed to help your practice and clients thrive.
[Request a demo][140]

## TheraNest

### Mental Health

TheraNest is a mental health EHR and practice management solution built to help you save time,
reduce admin, and run a successful practice.
[Start a free trial][141]

## Fusion

### Rehab Therapy

Fusion’s EHR simplifies documentation, scheduling, and billing – so physical, occupational, and
speech therapy teams can work through the day with ease.
[Request a demo][142]

## Lightening the load for every part of your practice

Whether you’re a solo therapist, part of a large group, or a member of the admin support staff,
we’re here to help you deliver exceptional care.

Mental health solo practices
When you’re a solo therapist, you carry the full weight of your practice. You need fewer systems to
manage, fewer fires to chase, and more space for meaningful moments. TheraNest helps you stay
organized and sustainable without extra effort.
[[Resources] Learn More][143]
Mental health group practices
Group practices juggle shifting schedules, tight cash flow, and costly no-shows. Supporting
clinicians and clients is key, but admin tasks feel overwhelming. You deserve a simpler path
forward.
[[Resources] Learn More][144]
Rehab therapy
Documentation, authorizations, and shifting schedules can push admin work late into the night. Built
by therapists who understand, Fusion streamlines your workflow in one EHR — so your PT/ OT/ SLP team
can avoid burnout and focus on clients.
[[Resources] Learn More][145]

## Practice success with Ensora Health

We build and fine-tune our solutions with input from clinicians, their clients, and practice owners
and administrators. That’s why they are designed to solve real problems, not just check boxes.

### TheraNest

Automate and simplify admin work with an all-in-one mental health EHR and PMS.

[Explore TheraNest][146]

Improve workflows and patient outcomes with the trusted EHR for physical, occupational, and speech
therapy.

LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then

## About Us

[Company][36]

### Reasons why people choose ITO

Over 100 years since the foundation in 1916, we have been developing numerous physiotherapy
products. Although our top-quality products have been widely acclaimed in Japan and overseas, we are
never satisfied with the current situation. We will continue to improve and develop new products to
create a more age-friendly and healthier society.

We have been exporting our high-quality products for over 30 years more than 100 countries through
our reliable partners in each country. To supply our products worldwide, we are certified for ISO
13485. We have also passed the strict international quality standards and specifications such as CE,
FDA and UL.

## See you in Bangkok

We are excited to meet you at the upcoming Bangkok Exhibition.

During the exhibition, our team will be presenting professional physiotherapy and rehabilitation
solutions, including our latest devices and application ideas for clinics, distributors, and
rehabilitation professionals. We warmly welcome all visitors, partners, and industry friends to
visit our booth, communicate with our team, and explore more cooperation opportunities together.

## New Launch
* **Piezonia,  redefined piezoelectric shockwave**
  
  ✅ High-precision piezoelectric focused shockwave
  ✅ Stable output with consistent energy performance
  ✅ Comfortable treatment with precise focal targeting
  ✅ 7 interchangeable depth pads for flexible adjustment
  ✅ 0-65 mm focal depth coverage
  
  ✅ Up to 5 million shots handpiece lifespan
  ✅ ntelligent programs and a 13.3-inch HD touchscreen for intuitive operation
  ✅ 3 intelligent modes for different treatment rhythms and clinical needs
  ✅ Wide frequency range from 1 to 10 Hz
  ✅ Durable design for long-term clinical use
  
  [ Learn more ][76]

[Piezonia]

Global Innovative Manufacturer of Physical Therapy Equipment

## Who are we？

Kaphaphysio is more than a manufacturer — we are innovators driven by a profound commitment to
physiotherapy. By integrating advanced R&D, dedicated production, and global distribution, we
deliver high-performance rehabilitation and therapy equipment tailored to diverse clinical
requirements.

## Technologies

We integrate the ten most popular technologies in rehabilitation and physical therapy—from shockwave
and laser to TECAR, ultrasound, PEMF, and beyond. Whatever your clinical focus—pain management,
functional recovery, or advanced treatment—we provide trusted, comprehensive solutions.

## Global exhibitions

Our products and technologies have been showcased at leading exhibitions across Europe, Southeast
Asia, the Middle East, and beyond. Through these international platforms, we engage directly with
therapists, distributors, and medical professionals—exchanging insights, exploring trends, and
building partnerships that drive the future of rehabilitation.

## Distributors

We pride ourselves on outstanding service capabilities, offering distributors tailored solutions,
professional training, and strategic marketing planning. With unwavering support from initial
concept to post-delivery and beyond, we are committed to driving your growth and achieving shared
success.

## Our Factory

Kaphaphysio delivers tailored solutions within 72 hours, backed by a 3,000㎡ modern production
facility and an in-house R&D team. We provide comprehensive OEM/ODM services and scalable
manufacturing capabilities to empower global partners with speed, flexibility, and reliability. [ Skip to content ][1]

## Explore Therapy Technologies & Devices

### Focused Shockwave Therapy

Focused shockwave therapy delivers concentrated acoustic energy into targeted tissue areas, making
it suitable for deep musculoskeletal conditions, chronic pain, tendon injuries, and precise
rehabilitation applications.
[ View Devices ][77] [ Learn Technology ][78]

### Radial Shockwave Therapy

Radial shockwave therapy spreads acoustic energy across a broader treatment area, making it ideal
for superficial pain, muscle tension, myofascial conditions, and sports recovery treatments.
[ View Devices ][79] [ Learn Technology ][80]

### Magneto Therapy

Magneto therapy uses pulsed electromagnetic fields to stimulate deeper tissues, support pain
management, improve recovery, and assist rehabilitation for muscles, joints, tendons, and soft
tissue conditions.
[ View Devices ][81] [ Learn Technology ][82]

### Laser Therapy

Laser therapy delivers therapeutic light energy to support tissue repair, reduce discomfort, improve
circulation, and assist recovery in physical therapy and rehabilitation settings.
[ View Devices ][83] [ Learn Technology ][84]

### Tecar Therapy

TECAR therapy uses capacitive and resistive radiofrequency energy to stimulate deep tissues, improve
circulation, support soft tissue recovery, and enhance rehabilitation efficiency.
[ View Devices ][85] [ Learn Technology ][86]

### Ultrasound Therapy

Ultrasound therapy uses high-frequency sound waves to penetrate soft tissues, support tissue
healing, relieve pain, and improve circulation in clinical physiotherapy applications.
[ View Devices ][87] [ Learn Technology ][88]

# We exist to improve children’s behavioral health across
# our region.

The New England Children’s Behavioral Health Network has a vision of a system of care that is
preventive, upstream, collaborative, accessible, equitable and family-centered. Through our advocacy
and network-building we work to improve children’s behavioral health across the region.

[ About Us ][42]

# Preventative

# Collaborative

# Accessible

# Equitable

**ABOUT US**

## Children’s behavioral health is our priority.

We know that the fragmentation of children’s behavioral health care is not unique to one state. The
Network’s collaborative, regional approach allows us to bring together stakeholders to learn and
pool resources. Our stakeholders are currently located across Rhode Island, Connecticut and
Massachusetts.

Welcome to **Psychowellness Center**, Delhi’s premier mental health clinic chain led by chief
practitioner **[Dr(Prof) R. K. Suri][35]****.** With  42+ years of clinical excellence, Dr. Suri

Niketan, Vasantkunj** and **Paschim Vihar**, Psychowellness Center offers a safe, confidential space
for holistic psychological healing.

commitment therapy][50] ([ABA)][51], [Expressive Arts Therapy][52], **and[** Occupational

growth.

Since 1984, the caring and skilled staff at Sierra Tucson has been dedicated to providing clinical
excellence and compassionate, effective treatment for all who are entrusted into our care.
Recommended by doctors and therapists across the world, we are recognized for providing safe and
successful treatment for those who are struggling with addiction and a wide range of complex
behavioral health disorders. Our renowned programs have resulted in positive change in the lives of
over 34,000 residents and more than 90,000 family members.

We are here to help you through this difficult time. It takes courage to seek treatment, and we are
committed to helping you through this process.

With extensive training and decades of experience, Sierra Tucson maintains a high standard of
excellence in the clinical treatment programs that we offer for individuals aged 18 and older, who
are struggling with [drug & alcohol
addiction][148], [depression][149], [anxiety][150], [trauma][151], and [co-occurring
disorders][152]. By utilizing a multidisciplinary approach, we help you learn how to successfully
manage symptoms, overcome challenges, and develop the skills needed to manage your disease and
return to your family, friends, and a productive lifestyle.

## Programs & Services

Adolescent Services

We provide current and former foster youth with individualized programing and support related to
successful transitions from systems of care to independence.

[Learn More][65]

Caregiver Supports Program

Essential services for caregivers - both licensed and unlicensed - who care for children placed by
the Department of Children, Youth, and Families (DCYF).

[Learn More][66]

Combined In-Home Services

Combined in-home services focuses on family preservation, education, and support services to
families whose children are at risk of removal due to abuse and/or neglect.

[Learn More][67]

Therapeutic Foster Network

Therapeutic Foster Network programs offer a variety of services to children and families, all of
which are designed to promote expedited and successful reunifications.

## Programs & Services

Adolescent Services

We provide current and former foster youth with individualized programing and support related to
successful transitions from systems of care to independence.

[Learn More][65]

Caregiver Supports Program

Essential services for caregivers - both licensed and unlicensed - who care for children placed by
the Department of Children, Youth, and Families (DCYF).

[Learn More][66]

Combined In-Home Services

Combined in-home services focuses on family preservation, education, and support services to
families whose children are at risk of removal due to abuse and/or neglect.

[Learn More][67]

Therapeutic Foster Network

Therapeutic Foster Network programs offer a variety of services to children and families, all of
which are designed to promote expedited and successful reunifications.

[Learn More][68]
